rules.text: When a tool refuses an action, your reply must say plainly what could NOT be done and why, and state the current status (for example: 'I can't cancel this appointment because it starts within 2 hours, so it is still booked'). Only then say clinic staff have been notified. Never reply with only 'staff will be in touch'.
rules.source: cancel_too_late: explains_why_not_cancelled failed on the baseline prompt
